recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes a real conformance inconsistency that could otherwise direct implementers to a language code absent from the current ExpressionLanguage value set; no further core source change is indicated for this seed.
issue_request: FHIR-38872 was a Published FHIR-core R5 change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking Expression support to include FHIR operations by moving x-fhir-query documentation into core, ensuring x-fhir-query covers URL-invocable operations, and defining a server-like FHIRPath API for operations needing body parameters such as StructureMap/$transform and ActivityDefinition/$apply.
initial_application: Commit 36365345c78a1ddcd443605a8c033a4dd757c61d initially applied the issue by adding source/fhir-xquery.html, linking it from documentation/hierarchy, adding x-fhir-query operation prose, and introducing the FHIRPath General Service API with %server.transform and %server.apply. The current source retained those semantics but still had application/x-fhir-query in source/fhir-xquery.html and source/datatypes/expression.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini makes Expression an active datatype and maps expression to metadatatypes; publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml include fhir-xquery.html, so both edited files are in current build scope. The active ExpressionLanguage value set and surrounding Expression/clinical reasoning narrative use text/x-fhir-query. FHIR-46082 later fixed a separate %server/%terminologies typo in the same FHIRPath area and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Changed source/fhir-xquery.html to refer to text/x-fhir-query and changed the Expression.language short text in source/datatypes/expression.xml from application/x-fhir-query to text/x-fhir-query. No additional operation semantics were changed because the operation example and %server.transform/%server.apply API already reflect the FHIR-38872 decision.
source_changes: source/fhir-xquery.html: changed both x-fhir-query language-code references from application/x-fhir-query to text/x-fhir-query.
source/datatypes/expression.xml: changed the Expression.language short text from application/x-fhir-query to text/x-fhir-query.
